name: Programming Fundamentals
description: Procedural logic, variable scopes, iteration, recursion, pointers, and memory addressing.
source: ACM/IEEE CS Curricula 2023, Programming Fundamentals (P-F)

name: Object-Oriented Design
description: Classes, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, design patterns, and modularity.
source: ACM/IEEE CS Curricula 2023, Software Development Fundamentals (SDF)

name: Linear Data Structures
description: Arrays, dynamic arrays, singly/doubly linked lists, stacks, queues, and deques.
source: ACM/IEEE CS Curricula 2023, Algorithms & Complexity (AL-Basic)

name: Trees, Heaps and Graphs
description: Binary search trees, balanced trees (AVL, Red-Black), binary heaps, priority queues, and graph representations.
source: ACM/IEEE CS Curricula 2023, Algorithms & Complexity (AL-Advanced)

name: Algorithm Design & Complexity
description: Asymptotic analysis (Big-O), divide-and-conquer, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, and network flow.
source: ACM/IEEE CS Curricula 2023, Algorithms & Complexity (AL-Design)

name: Discrete Mathematics & Logic
description: Propositional logic, predicate calculus, set theory, combinatorics, relations, and proof techniques.
source: ACM/IEEE CS Curricula 2023, Discrete Structures (DS)

name: Linear Algebra
description: Matrix operations, determinants, vector spaces, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and singular value decomposition (SVD).
source: IIT Delhi MTL101 Syllabus, Maths Dept

name: Multivariable Calculus
description: Limits, derivatives, Taylor expansion, partial differentiation, multiple integration, and gradient vector fields.
source: IIT Delhi MTL100 Syllabus, Maths Dept

name: Probability & Stochastic Processes
description: Random variables, probability distributions, expectation, Central Limit Theorem, and Markov chains.
source: IIT Delhi MTL106 Syllabus, Maths Dept

name: Relational Databases & SQL
description: Entity-relationship modeling, relational algebra, SQL DDL/DML, joins, subqueries, and normalization (1NF-BCNF).
source: ACM/IEEE CS Curricula 2023, Information Management (IM-Data)

name: Database Internals & Transactions
description: B+ tree indexing, query execution engines, ACID transaction management, two-phase locking, and crash recovery.
source: ACM/IEEE CS Curricula 2023, Information Management (IM-Architecture)

name: OS Concurrency & Threads
description: Processes, kernel threads, race conditions, synchronization primitives (mutex, semaphores), and deadlock avoidance.
source: ACM/IEEE CS Curricula 2023, Operating Systems (OS-Concurrency)

name: Virtual Memory & File Systems
description: Page tables, TLB, demand paging, page replacement algorithms, file inodes, and storage I/O subsystems.
source: ACM/IEEE CS Curricula 2023, Operating Systems (OS-Memory)

name: Computer Architecture & RISC-V
description: Instruction set architectures, CPU pipelining, data forwarding, branch prediction, and multi-level cache hierarchies.
source: ACM/IEEE CS Curricula 2023, Systems Fundamentals (SF-Arch)

name: Supervised Machine Learning
description: Linear and logistic regression, Support Vector Machines (SVM), decision trees, gradient boosting, and regularization.
source: IIT Delhi COL774 Syllabus / Stanford CS229

name: Unsupervised Learning & Clustering
description: K-means clustering, Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM), Expectation-Maximization, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA).
source: IIT Delhi COL774 Syllabus / Stanford CS229

name: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
description: Multilayer perceptrons, backpropagation calculus, convolution, attention mechanisms, and deep representation learning.
source: IIT Delhi COL774 Syllabus / Deep Learning Book (Goodfellow)

name: Parallel & Distributed Systems
description: Shared-memory multi-threading (OpenMP), message passing (MPI), GPU kernel programming (CUDA), and distributed consensus.
source: IIT Delhi COL380 Syllabus, CSE Dept

name: Software Engineering & CI/CD
description: Git branching, unit and integration testing, continuous integration pipelines, RESTful APIs, and system architecture.
source: IIT Delhi COP290 Syllabus, CSE Dept

name: Fluid Flow & Transport Phenomena
description: Navier-Stokes equations, boundary layer theory, shell momentum balance, and laminar vs. turbulent flow dynamics.
source: Bird, Stewart, Lightfoot Transport Phenomena / IIT Delhi CLL110

name: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics
description: Equations of state, fugacity coefficients, activity coefficient models, and multicomponent vapor-liquid equilibria.
source: Smith, Van Ness Chemical Thermodynamics / IIT Delhi CLL121

name: Reaction Engineering & Kinetics
description: Reaction rate kinetics, ideal batch, CSTR, and PFR design, thermal stability, and porous catalyst effectiveness factors.
source: Fogler Elements of Chemical Reaction Engineering / IIT Delhi CLL122

name: Heat Transfer & Exchanger Design
description: Conduction, convection heat transfer coefficients, thermal radiation, and industrial shell-and-tube exchanger rating.
source: Incropera Heat and Mass Transfer / IIT Delhi CLL251

name: Mass Transfer & Separation Operations
description: Molecular diffusion, interphase mass transfer, McCabe-Thiele distillation column design, and gas absorption columns.
source: Treybal Mass-Transfer Operations / IIT Delhi CLL252

name: Process Dynamics & Feedback Control
description: Laplace transfer functions, first and second-order process responses, PID feedback controller tuning, and stability criteria.
source: Seborg Process Dynamics and Control / IIT Delhi CLL261

name: Venture Creation & Product Discovery
description: Lean startup validation, customer discovery interviews, business model generation, and product-market fit metrics.
source: IIT Delhi MSL705 / Stanford Technology Ventures Program

name: Venture Valuation & Financial Modeling
description: Cap tables, term sheets, discounted cash flows (DCF), cost of capital, and venture capital financing rounds.
source: IIT Delhi MSL708 / Harvard Business School Venture Capital

name: Indian Social Structures & Polity
description: Indian constitutional frameworks, caste and agrarian dynamics, federalism, secularism, and public administration.
source: IIT Delhi HUL261 / UPSC Civil Services Syllabus GS Paper 1 & 2

name: Environmental Governance & Ecology
description: Ecological sustainability, global climate agreements, natural resource governance, and environmental jurisprudence.
source: IIT Delhi HUL275 / UPSC Civil Services Syllabus GS Paper 3

name: Cognitive Psychology & Decision Making
description: Human memory architecture, heuristic biases, cognitive load theory, and behavioral decision analysis.
source: IIT Delhi HUL211 / Kahneman Thinking Fast and Slow
